newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle sales thin at $67 -feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle sales thin at $67 -feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle sold at $67.00 per cwt in light volume early Friday, steady with Thursday's prices, feedlot sources said.

About 200 head sold in Kansas, sources there said. Sales in Kansas were tied to clean-up activity following moderate sales on Thursday. Weekly sales could be near 80,000 head there by the time all the paperwork is done, they said.
No sales were reported early Friday in the Texas Panhandle following weekly sales close to 109,000 head. This week's showlist there was reportedly depleted, they said.
